estimand.primary: Taxon-equal expected share of genuine, visibly open-flower white photographic labels in prespecified equal-area habitat cells, conditional on photographed and classifiable flowers in the eligible previously-unseen iNaturalist observation universe.
estimand.data_unit: unique_source_observation_id, with all attached source photos retained and averaged within observation
estimand.season_SI: separate taxon × equal-area cell × local meteorological season, with observer/effort sensitivity; missing seasonal photographs NOT interpreted as biological absence
estimand.mixed_colour_species: retain photo-derived proportional white probability; do not force majority phenotype for known polymorphic taxa
estimand.species_level_polymorphism: Use signed externally validated FCP D only where taxon IDs align and D is independently sourced; otherwise mark D missing, do not impute monomorphism.
estimand.interpretation: photographically encountered and machine or independently verified visible flower colours, not population abundance or adaptive fitness

historical_exploration.island_core_result: 313535 prior island–mainland raw +4.223pp and adjusted +3.160pp, source-dependent, already seen
historical_exploration.elevation_core_result: previous raw white share falls with elevation; already seen
historical_exploration.arctic_core_result: previous exploratory >66.562N white share 43.987%; already seen
historical_exploration.moisture_core_result: positive water/vapour slopes attenuated under spatial conditioning; already seen
historical_exploration.season_core_result: south summer−winter +10.496pp photographed WHITE, common photographed taxon frequency term +8.036pp, already seen
historical_exploration.possible_brightness_result: image brightness odds ratio must be source-verified independently; do not treat user-proposed OR as measured fact here
historical_exploration.inference_status: historical datasets only exploratory, not confirmatory regardless of protocols authored now

directional_hypotheses.modifier: UVB1 and temperature needed; bee richness and habitat alternative
linked water family with H5; not independent mechanistic proof

directional_hypotheses.contrast: native-only island vs native-only mainland, comparable latitude/realm and cell coverage
directional_hypotheses.modifier: requires separately verified island native/introduced status; WCVP TDWG3 alone does not establish native for a specific islet

directional_hypotheses.contrast: latitude>=66.562 north vs matched non-Arctic high-latitude land cells
directional_hypotheses.biological_explanation: candidate pollinator limitation; photos and introduced flora confounding
directional_hypotheses.modifier: not tested by treating all Southern Hemisphere as one analogue

directional_hypotheses.biological_explanation: candidate water balance and pollination associations
directional_hypotheses.modifier: correlated with H2 and thermal stress, joint identifiability gate required

contextual_predictors.UVB: glUV UVB1, 15 arcminute UVB annual mean, OMI-era 2004–2013; NO substitution of shortwave WorldClim solar Wm2 for UVB
contextual_predictors.pollinators: independent validated spatial bee richness with coverage, scale and effort uncertainty; global bee abundance or effective visitation NOT assumed
contextual_predictors.image_brightness: reconstruct source-authenticated image exposure/illumination proxy outcome-blind; absent or unavailable must remain unknown, not assumed equal
contextual_predictors.photo_effort: all identifiable plant observations and unique observer IDs per cell/month if available, never count only four-hue classification successes as effort denominator

model.response: four_hue_white_positive, chromatic_other, with photo-origin observation clustering and taxon × equal-area-cell aggregation
model.spatial_dependence: equal_area_100km_cell spatial cluster/block and smooth spatial random effect
model.taxonomy_dependence: accepted_genus random effect plus family if source taxonomy validated; not dated phylogeny
model.collinearity: prior standardize on training folds; if correlated water terms not identifiable report water_block_only and DO NOT assign separate stress/pollinator pathways
model.numerical_method: regularised hierarchical binomial/beta-binomial/partial pooling with cluster-aware calibration; compare against geography-only, taxonomy-only and effort-only baselines
model.separate_bee_model: fit only after independently validated spatial source and adequate joint coverage, no causal mediation inference
model.quality: blinded flower/petal organ review and independent error calibration on pre-hue selected classifiable AND unknown original image attempts
model.temperature_source: annual/long-term WorldClim not actual observation-month weather
model.prediction: spatial and held-out genus blocked validation, not random per-photo split

inference.multiplicity: Holm familywise 0.05 for five directional tests in untouched holdout; joint water H2/H5 not counted as independent replications
inference.output_if_no_independent_bee_source: No pollinator pathway hypothesis tested; publish abiotic joint conditional associations only
inference.output_if_native_resolution_mismatch: No native-only island confirmation; report explicit unknown/native match coverage
